note: Machine-readable half of docs/art/ART_BIBLE_1974.md. The game and the bible read the same values; do not hand-copy a hex into code. Regenerate or extend here first, then describe it in the bible.
principle: A future imagined in 1974, not a future photographed in 2045. Period materials, period limits, period optimism and dread.

notes: No 1980s neon-on-black grid. Glow exists, but as phosphor and CRT bloom, not as magenta-and-cyan gradient.
Earth tones carry weight: mustard, brass, paper, steel. The psychedelia is in the accent, not the base.
Every colour pair used for text must pass WCAG AA contrast; the acid family is for surfaces and accents, not for body text on paper.

typography.licence_requirement: SIL OFL or Apache-2.0 only. No commercial film or album lettering, no traced logotypes.

display.category: heavy geometric or poster grotesque; the lettering of a 1974 science-fiction paperback or concert bill
display.usage: titles, location names, section headers; never below 24 px

body.category: humanist sans with high legibility at small sizes
body.usage: dialogue, evidence text, descriptions; 16-18 px minimum

rules: Body text is never set in a display face.
All-caps is for labels and headers only, never for prose.
No lower-case-only gimmick that costs readability.

texture.rule: Texture is a layer over readable content and must be switchable off; it never dims text.

motion.tempo: slow drift over snappy cuts; the camera should feel hand-cranked, not eased
motion.reduced_motion: every signature move has a static equivalent; honour the OS setting

audio_interface.rule: all interface sound is original or licensed; no sampled film or record audio

layout.rule: Corners are square or nearly square; heavy rounding reads 2010s, not 1974.

accessibility.not_colour_alone: every state also carries shape, icon or label
accessibility.screen_reader: all evidence, dialogue and graph nodes are text-labelled
